why: Third measured occurrence (2026-10-19, Discovery report) of worker-temp-file-collided-across-sessions: writers told to delete the scratch scripts after removed the orchestrator's provision.mjs, engram-save.mjs, mirror-odd.mjs, split-backlog.mjs and contrast.mjs from the shared session scratchpad root. shared-temp-guard stops a delegated agent writing into the shared TEMP root; this guard stops it deleting a file it did not create. Authorship is recorded by effect in a per-agent journal and confirmed by the agent's own completed call: PreToolUse (Bash, PowerShell, Write, MultiEdit) judges a deletion and records the call's start and its absent creation targets; PostToolUse on the same tools confirms the targets that now exist with their file identity and records the call's end, which a call another guard denied or a command that failed never reaches. The main session is never judged.
